demo.title: Online payment is running in test (demo) mode
demo.text: No money is charged, no SMS is sent and your card details never leave your browser. A manager will contact you to complete the payment — if you would rather not wait, <contact>write to us</contact>.
demo.card: Card: any number that passes the Luhn check, e.g. <mono>{card}</mono>; expiry — any future month.
demo.other: Any other code — the 'wrong code' message
demo.paid: This is a demo payment: no money was taken from the card and no email or SMS was sent. A manager will contact you to complete the payment — if you would rather not wait, <contact>write to us</contact>.

method.title: Choose a payment method
method.lead: The payment is processed by the bank. Card data is never stored on our servers.

card.title: Card details
card.trustPrivacy: Card details are not stored or sent to a server
card.trustVoucher: You can download the voucher after payment

bank.title: Payment by invoice
bank.text: Companies pay by bank transfer. Send our manager the booking number and your company details — we will prepare the contract and the invoice.
bank.step2: Send the company name, tax ID and bank details
bank.step3: The manager holds the booking manually until the invoice is issued

otp.title: Enter the SMS code
otp.hint: {phone} — a six-digit code was sent to this number
otp.label: Confirmation code

errors.card_invalid: Invalid card number. Please check it.
errors.phone_required: Enter the phone number for SMS
errors.phone_format: Enter the full number: +998 and 9 digits
errors.otp_incomplete: Enter all 6 digits of the code
errors.otp_expired: The confirmation code has expired. Please try again.
errors.provider_unavailable: The payment system is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

success.title: Payment successful
success.text: The demo payment was accepted and the booking is marked as paid in this browser.

declined.title: Payment declined
declined.text: {minutes, plural, one {Insufficient funds. Your booking is held for another # minute.} other {Insufficient funds. Your booking is held for another # minutes.}}

expired.title: The payment window expired
expired.text: No payment arrived within 30 minutes and the seats were released. You can pick a date again.

error.title: Technical error
error.text: The connection to the bank dropped. No money was taken — try again in a few minutes.

steps.balance: Check the card balance or try another card
steps.bankOnline: Confirm with your bank that online payments are enabled
steps.manager: If it keeps failing, message our manager and we'll hold the booking manually
steps.pickDate: Pick a date again — seats are still available
steps.later: Try again in a few minutes

notFound.title: Booking not found
notFound.text: Booking {id} was not found in this browser. For now a booking is stored only on this device and in this window — the link may have been opened on another device or in a new window.
notFound.step1: Go back to the window where you made the booking and finish the payment there
notFound.step2: If that window is closed, choose the tour again and make a new booking

voucher.title: Travel voucher
voucher.demoNote: Test document — no payment was made, this document is not valid.

click.lead: Payment is processed by the CLICK payment system. You enter your card details on the Click page — they never reach our server and are not stored.

app.name: Via Click
app.note: Click app or Click page: by phone number or card

card.name: By card
card.note: Uzcard or Humo — enter the number and expiry in the Click window

click.loadError: We couldn't open the Click payment window. Use “Pay with Click” or try again later.
click.failed: The payment didn't go through. Check your card details and balance and try again.
click.trust: Card details are entered only in Click

checking.title: Checking your payment
checking.text: Waiting for confirmation from Click. This usually takes a few seconds — please keep this page open.

pending.title: Payment not confirmed yet
pending.text: If the money has left your card, confirmation arrives within a few minutes — tap “Check status”. If it hasn't, try again.

click.successText: Your payment was received via Click. A manager will contact you shortly and send the documents.
click.notFound: Booking {id} was not found. The link may not have been copied in full.
